source_conflict_analysis.analysis: This row itself contains no contradictory values. The adjacent same-item/different-code row creates an applicability and evidence-separation requirement, but atomic source identity permits distinct project mappings without assuming a Master contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A passive HSC identity/status/telemetry operation and safety boundary are definable. The exact board/channel mapping and adjacent-code differentiation are project inputs; once supplied, this code can have a deterministic plan under ED-04.

review_improvement: Preserves the critical hot-swap blast radius, rejects an invented physical-only test, and adds code-specific differentiation so two HSC_BD rows cannot reuse one target or evidence set silently.
independent_technical_reasoning: Hot-swap controllers combine passive telemetry and state-changing gate/protection controls in the same register space. Therefore the safe evidence boundary is a code-specific board/channel map and strict passive-read allowlist. The repeated HSC_BD item is not proof of duplication or equivalence; it requires separate binding, but does not prevent conditional automation once that binding exists.
